## Demo booking
1. **Demo Input Guard**: title forced to "DEMO - <name>", notes = service only (no free text).
2. **Count Session Bookings / Booking Limit Check**: max 2 demo appointments per chat session.
3. Engine (unchanged, plus the optional break rule): calendar lock, hours, closing time, closed day, conflicts, duplicate protection.
Calendar and rules come from DEMO CONFIG (input `demo_config`).
